name: sortable-list
title: Sortable list
description: A list the user reorders by dragging a handle or with the keyboard, with live announcements.
a11y: Each row has a handle button named 'Reorder <item>' with aria-pressed while picked up and a description of the keys.
Space or Enter picks an item up; the arrow keys (or Home and End) move it; Space or Enter drops it; Escape cancels and restores the order; Tab cancels.
A polite live region announces: picked up, moved to position N of M, dropped, cancelled.
Pointer drag uses the same handle; reordering never depends on dragging alone.
